[PRIOR RECORD (escalation_receipt; decision_status: tl_approved; execution_status: handoff_recorded; outcome_status: open) - history, not a standing rule.]
## Incident scope
Earlier batch-15 reports RP15-S201, RP15-S202 and RP15-S203 described a disabled Submit button after the required fields were filled. The local record identifier is SIM-ENG-RP-20260928-01; it is a synthetic internal receipt, not a link to a real ticketing service.

## Advice and approval
The simulated Advisor recommended collecting field state, task IDs, time and button behavior, then escalating the report. Alex approved an engineering handoff.

## Handoff receipt
At 16:30 UTC on September 28, Alex recorded sending the three task references and screenshots to Daniel (U005, ENGINEER). Daniel's recorded acknowledgment at 16:45 UTC was: “Received these three examples. I can reproduce a disabled control in one trace; checking the validation state. No shared cause or repair is confirmed.”

citation.title: Reject a universal browser-zoom remedy for Submit reports

k:rp-submit-zoom-generalization-rejected.excerpt:
[PRIOR RECORD (advice_review; decision_status: tl_rejected; execution_status: not_executed; outcome_status: resolved_in_checked_tasks) - history, not a standing rule.]
## Evidence available at review

The September 7 support notes cover RP14-Z011 and RP14-Z012 on a training workstation. At 200% browser zoom, the bottom of the form, including Submit, lay below the visible area. The button was not observed to be disabled. Returning the browser to 100% exposed the button, and both tasks produced a submission receipt: SIM-SUB-RP14-Z011 and SIM-SUB-RP14-Z012.

No network error or server rejection was recorded. These two cases were already resolved before this advice review; no action in response to the rejected recommendation has been executed.

## Prior ThreadSense advice

Add a standard FAQ answer telling every tutor with a Submit problem to reset browser zoom to 100% before reporting the issue.
